about_the_game:
I know what you're thinking-"Maybe if I was a beetle, my life wouldn't suck". Newsflash pal, you're right. How could a beetle playing soccer with dung balls be sad? Anyway, that's why we've invested our life savings into bringing you Beetleball, the greatest online multiplayer class-based dung beetle soccer game to ever exist.

A TON OF UNIQUE BEETLE CLASSES

We've got beetles by the boatload, and each of them have their own crazy abilities that can change the tide of a match. Turn the field into a slip and slide with the Bombardier beetle, teleport from ball to ball with the Tiger beetle, and vaporize your enemies with a six legged orbital strike Goliath beetle, and do many many more wacky things with other beetles.

SO MANY COOL MAPS

Glide from dandelions to donuts, roll a dungball over a cake (ew) or maybe even headbutt someone off of a pyramid! Beetleball isn't limited by normal FLAT and BORING soccer fields. Each map has a unique layout that keeps each match feeling as fun as a beetle balling.

If you love beetles and you also love balls, you'll love Beetleball!

  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 760, AMD Radeon R7 270X, or better
